Treatment summary
Pateint presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain and reduced range of motion.
The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the knee trauma described. Imaging and physical examination findings
clearly confirm a knee injury. There is no reocrd of prior injury or treatment involving the same region. Over the course of care
the patient attended 36 visits, with attendance occurring nearly every day for much of the treatment period. Treatment volume ran
well above what is typical for this condition. Several weeks after the collision, complaints were added involving the neck and
lower back, which were not part of the initial presentation. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicated or
repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing care and reassessment are recommended, with the treatment plan to be reviewed
at the next scheduled evaluation.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
